The machine · Kukirin G2

The same scooter you ride in the game.

Rendered straight out of Roblox Studio — this is the actual in-game G2, not a stock photo. Keep scrolling to get closer.

01 · Suspension

The shocks actually travel.

Front and rear suspension are modelled, not faked with a camera shake. Hit a kerb hard and the deck dips, the front unloads, and your line changes.

02 · Balance

Wheelies are held, not pressed.

Lean back past the balance point and you loop out. Find it and feather the throttle, and you can carry the front wheel for as long as your nerve lasts.

03 · Throttle

Torque you can feel.

The same input does something different uphill than it does flat out. Weight transfer and grip are simulated, so a clean throttle hand is worth learning.

Kukirin G2 · in-game modelRendered in Roblox Studio

Approach

Easy to start. Worth getting good at.

Anyone can be moving in a few seconds. The depth sits in the handling, whether or not you go looking for it.

Throttle you can feel

Torque, weight transfer and grip are all simulated, so the same input does something different uphill than it does flat out.

Balance is a skill

Wheelies are not a button press. Find the balance point, hold it with small corrections, and the game gives you credit for it.

Roads that go somewhere

Maps are laid out for riding rather than for filling space — connected routes, shortcuts that pay off, and room to just cruise.

One lobby, every device

Controls are tuned for touch first, then keyboard and controller, so phone players and PC players ride in the same server.

Before you join

Twenty server rules, in plain language

Read them once and you will never think about them again. Most of it is just being decent to people.

Gogos Games Studios

Discord server rules

Breaking these gets you a warning, a mute, a kick, a ban or a blacklist depending on how bad it is. Most people never hit any of them.

01
Be respectfulNo harassment, bullying, discrimination, threats, personal attacks or piling on.
02
Nothing NSFWNo sexual, graphic or disturbing content. Plenty of people here are young — keep it that way.
03
Watch the emojisDo not use emojis or reactions in a sexual, offensive or deliberately disrespectful way.
04
No mocking reactionsClown, skull, middle-finger and laughing reactions aimed at one person count as harassment.
05
No spam or floodingNo message, emoji, GIF or mention spam, repeated images, wall-to-wall caps or channel flooding.
06
No advertisingNo promoting games, servers, socials, channels, sites or products without asking staff first.
07
No scammingScams, phishing, fake giveaways or account theft get you banned immediately, without a warning.
08
No unsafe links or filesDo not post suspicious links, executables or downloads that could harm someone's device or account.
09
Do not ping the ownerOnly if it is genuinely urgent, or you have been asked to.
10
Do not DM the ownerNo DMs asking for roles, Robux, partnerships, free items or attention. Repeat offenders get blacklisted.
11
Do not beg for rolesTester, Moderator, Admin, Builder and Developer all go through the application system.
12
Ping staff sparinglyOne ping when you actually need help. Do not chase several staff about the same thing.
13
Use the right channelKeep conversations where they belong and follow anything pinned in that channel.
14
No impersonationDo not pretend to be staff, developers, creators or other members.
15
Do not leakUnreleased updates, tester builds, staff conversations, screenshots and private assets stay private.
16
No exploits or cheatsDo not share, request, advertise or use anything that gives an unfair edge in our games.
17
No false reportsFake reports, made-up evidence and time-wasting are treated as rule-breaking themselves.
18
English in public channelsSo moderators can read what is happening. DMs and voice are your own business.
19
Respect staff decisionsDisagree with a call? Message staff calmly. Do not start an argument in public.
20
Follow Discord and RobloxTheir terms and community guidelines apply here at all times, on top of everything above.

Worth knowing: using alt accounts to dodge a punishment gets you permanently blacklisted. So do scams, leaks, staff harassment and repeat offending — sometimes without a further warning. Use common sense; we cannot write a rule for everything.

Joining the server means you accept these rules
